content: The IR models and the RQE Logistic Regression model bring different perspectives to the search for relevant candidate questions. In particular, question entailment allows understanding the relations between the important terms, whereas the traditional IR methods identify the important terms, but will not notice if the relations are opposite. Moreover, some of the question types that the RQE classifier learns will not be deemed important terms by traditional IR and the most relevant questions will not be ranked at the top of the list.
